6: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
7: pub struct HttpResponse {
8:     status_code: u16,
9:     reason_phrase: &'static str,
10:     body: &'static str,
11:     allow_get: bool,
12: }
13: 
14: impl HttpResponse {
15:     pub fn status_code(self) -> u16 {
16:         self.status_code
17:     }
18: 
19:     pub fn content_type(self) -> &'static str {
20:         JSON_CONTENT_TYPE
21:     }
22: 
23:     pub fn body(self) -> &'static str {
24:         self.body
25:     }
26: 
27:     pub fn allow(self) -> Option<&'static str> {
28:         self.allow_get.then_some("GET")
29:     }
30: 
31:     pub fn write_to<W: Write>(self, writer: &mut W) -> io::Result<()> {
32:         write!(
33:             writer,
34:             "HTTP/1.1 {} {}\r\nContent-Type: {}\r\nContent-Length: {}\r\n",
35:             self.status_code,
36:             self.reason_phrase,
37:             JSON_CONTENT_TYPE,
38:             self.body.len()
39:         )?;
40: 
41:         if self.allow_get {
42:             writer.write_all(b"Allow: GET\r\n")?;
43:         }
44: 
45:         writer.write_all(b"Connection: close\r\n\r\n")?;
46:         writer.write_all(self.body.as_bytes())?;
47:         writer.flush()
48:     }
49: }
50: 
51: pub fn response_for(method: &str, target: &str) -> HttpResponse {
52:     let path = target.split(['?', '#']).next().unwrap_or(target);
53: 
54:     if path == "/ping" {
55:         if method == "GET" {
56:             return HttpResponse {
57:                 status_code: 200,
58:                 reason_phrase: "OK",
59:                 body: r#"{"message":"pong"}"#,
60:                 allow_get: false,
61:             };
62:         }
63: 
64:         return HttpResponse {
65:             status_code: 405,
66:             reason_phrase: "Method Not Allowed",
67:             body: r#"{"error":"Method Not Allowed"}"#,
68:             allow_get: true,
69:         };
70:     }
71:

74:         reason_phrase: "Not Found",
75:         body: r#"{"error":"Not Found"}"#,

77:     }
78: }

80: pub fn handle_connection(mut stream: TcpStream) -> io::Result<()> {
81:     let mut request_line = String::new();
82:     {
83:         let mut reader = BufReader::new(&mut stream);
84:         if reader.read_line(&mut request_line)? == 0 {
85:             return Ok(());
86:         }
87:     }
88: 
89:     let mut request_parts = request_line.split_whitespace();
90:     let method = request_parts.next().unwrap_or("");
91:     let target = request_parts.next().unwrap_or("/");
92: 
93:     response_for(method, target).write_to(&mut stream)
94: }

18:

21: # {"message":"pong"}
22: ```
23: 
24: Only `GET /ping` is supported. Unknown routes return `404`, and other methods
25: on `/ping` return `405`.
26: 
27: ## Verify
28: 
29: ```bash
30: npm test
31: ```
32: 
33: ## Go and Rust
34:

36: Each directory is self-contained and includes its own run and test instructions.
37: 
38: All three implementations expose the same contract:
39:

+    return port
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    host = os.environ.get("HOST", DEFAULT_HOST)
+    port = parse_port(os.environ.get("PORT", str(DEFAULT_PORT)))
+    server = ThreadingHTTPServer((host, port), PingRequestHandler)
+
+    print(f"Ping-pong API listening on http://{host}:{port}", flush=True)
+    try:
+        server.serve_forever()
+    except KeyboardInterrupt:
+        pass
+    finally:
+        server.server_close()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
